welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Real-time deadlift form analysis powered by on-device AI. Create an account to save sessions, or continue as a guest to explore the app.
welcome.featureBody: MoveNet Lightning tracks pose keypoints from the camera for instant form cues on each rep — no extra wearables required.
welcome.step1Body: Place your phone 5–7 feet away with a full-body view from the side.
welcome.step2Body: Execute your set as normal. The AI detects start and end points automatically.
welcome.step3Body: Receive instant feedback on depth, pathing, and tempo.
welcome.infoNote: Guest mode lets you try workouts locally. Sign in to sync progress and unlock full Stats history.
welcome.languageSub: Choose your preferred language for the app.

onboarding.welcomeBody: RepRight uses AI and your phone's camera to detect biomechanical errors in real time — no trainer required.
onboarding.languageTitleBilingual: Choose your language / Elige tu idioma
onboarding.languageSub: Select your preferred language for the training experience.
onboarding.cameraSub: RepRight needs your camera to analyze your form in real time. Your video is processed entirely on your device — never uploaded.
onboarding.getStartedSub: Join the performance community and track your progress.
onboarding.guestHint: Guest sessions are not saved across devices.
